newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE - Russia Cen. Bank sells 200 bln rbls of bills.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Russia Cen. Bank sells 200 bln rbls of bills.

text.p: The central bank sold 200.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Tuesday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
The bank made the following transactions:
The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21079 issue closed on Tuesday at 85.06 percent and the 21082 issue closed at 84.55 percent.

Apart from intervening on its own account for liquidity-smoothing and monetary policy purposes, the central bank buys and sells securities as part of its management of the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
